provider.3aigent-gui.channel.direct-line: Bidirectional in-browser chat via the Greentic 3AIgent GUI Direct Line server, with the 3point skin and Greentic SSO enabled by default
provider.3aigent-gui.secret.jwt_signing_: Signing key for hosted GUI session JWTs; auto-generated by the runner if omitted
provider.3aigent-gui.secret.oauth_google: Client secret from Google Cloud Console, required when Google sign-in is enabled
provider.3aigent-gui.secret.oauth_micros: Client secret from Azure App Registration, required when Microsoft sign-in is enabled
provider.3aigent-gui.secret.oauth_github: Client secret from a GitHub OAuth App, required when GitHub sign-in is enabled
provider.3aigent-gui.config.public_base_: Public base URL used to derive hosted GUI and Direct Line routes
provider.3aigent-gui.config.mode.label: Delivery Mode
provider.3aigent-gui.config.mode.help: Delivery mode used by the runner (local_queue, websocket, or pubsub)
provider.3aigent-gui.config.route.label: Route
provider.3aigent-gui.config.route.help: Routing key or channel route used for outbound messages
provider.3aigent-gui.config.tenant_chann: Tenant-scoped channel identifier used for webchat routing
provider.3aigent-gui.config.base_url.hel: Optional host base URL for push/websocket endpoints
provider.3aigent-gui.config.presentation: Standalone hosted page or framework-independent Web Component embed mode
provider.3aigent-gui.config.skin.label: Skin
provider.3aigent-gui.config.text_input_e: Whether the embedded Web Component should show the text input box
provider.3aigent-gui.config.nav_links.he: Top-menu links used by standalone mode
provider.3aigent-gui.config.oauth_enable: Whether OAuth login (including Greentic SSO) is offered on the hosted GUI
